changes.before: The owner-directed ten-rank ladder, updated 23 October 2026, is Guild Master, High Council, Treasurer, Officer, Raid Leader, Veteran, Raider, Member, Alt and Initiate. The current five-rank beta game configuration is a different observed state. This book does not claim the ten-rank ladder has been applied in the game. High Council occupies one-based native Slot 2; Treasurer occupies Slot 3 (zero-based index 2), directly above Officer Slot 4. Co-Guild Master remains a separately accepted office. A named Treasury appointment and that character rank remain separate. A Council seat, eligible vote, character rank and actual permission are never silently interchangeable.
changes.after: Build .199 current owner direction: the exact ten-rank ladder is Leader (Guild Master), High Council, Officer, Officer Alt, Raid Leader, Veteran, Raider, Member, Alt and Initiate. Display ranks are 1–10; zero-based native slots are 0–9. High Council is Rank 2 / Slot 1; Officer Rank 3 / Slot 2; Officer Alt Rank 4 / Slot 3. Co-Guild Master and Treasurer are appointments within the Leader / High Council tier, not additional native ranks. The [Olympus Role & Rank Rosetta Stone](#/roles/rosetta-stone) joins the current guide, all 95 stable offices / 131 assignable keys and six application tracks. Historical beta-five game observations and older ladder proposals are dated technical history, not competing current recommendations. This book records no executed game promotion; accepted Council seat, eligible vote, character rank and actual permission remain separate.

High Council is also the second native character rank in the adopted ten-rank ladder. A Council seat, its mandate and eligible vote, a character's native rank and actual system permissions are separate records. A rank label creates no Council seat; this book and an unissued warrant assign no rank or access. The Treasury office remains an accepted High Council appointment, distinct from the current Treasurer native rank at Slot 3. A native rank does not create that office or its vote. The documented High Council bank preset includes Withdraw Gold and Modify Bank Tabs for all characters holding that rank; actual application must be separately authorized and verified, with the auditor conflict in section 1.7 resolved.

changes.before: The owner’s chosen schedule applies to verified additional contributions within each ninety-day season: Tithe Payer requires at least 25 additional gold, Patron of the Treasury at least 100, and Benefactor of Olympus at least 500. At most the highest currently qualified tier is shown, as cosmetic colour only, and every award lapses at that season’s end. There is no permanent donor rank or rolling lifetime credit; a new season needs its own eligible receipts. The title identifies the tier without publishing a balance. The website never publishes a member's exact amount, receipt, hardship status, private ledger or payment correspondence. A person may decline public recognition without losing credit or guild standing.

changes.before: Sign in through Discord, review the guild rules, select an activity suited to your time, and use the current verification instructions for the character you intend to link. An application, a vote and an invite are separate steps. Check the evidence timestamp on capacity information and do not treat a missing guild report as zero members. The Olympus role-holder directory lists eligible members by default with an opt-out; extra details and Workshop offers remain voluntary opt-in publications. Do not treat the rest of Asmongold’s server as the guild directory. Ask the responsible officer for a correction; retain a private operation receipt when an action is pending. Cosmetic donations are optional and never buy authority or priority. Account-data controls remain the route for your own download and serving-account erasure.
